subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should MessagePresentation gain a portable aggregate multi-select contract, and which channels must be supported in its first accepted version?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is absent, but code cannot decide the permanent public callback shape or whether Telegram and WhatsApp degradation belongs in the initial contract.

options.title: Add portable batch select
options.body: Define an additive aggregate selected-values callback, implement Discord and Slack native rendering plus deterministic text fallback, and treat richer Telegram UI as explicit follow-up work.

options.title: Keep portable select scalar
options.body: Leave MessagePresentation unchanged and document provider-specific components or plugins as the supported path for batch selection.

options.title: Design a broader forms API
options.body: Sponsor a canonical dialog/forms RFC covering multi-field and multi-select collection, then supersede this issue only after that work has an approved owner and scope.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch select
recommendation.body: Define an additive aggregate selected-values callback, implement Discord and Slack native rendering plus deterministic text fallback, and treat richer Telegram UI as explicit follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The current public presentation contract history and prior issue review place the product/API choice closest to this owner.
